text:
Ava: Quick design check — noticed the in-product help panel uses ‘Docs’ in one place and ‘Help’ in another. Also the panel close button is missing an aria-label in the current build. Screenshot in thread.
Priya: Good catch. Our guideline prefers ‘Help’ for microcopy and ‘Docs’ for the longer site. We should surface a clear crosslink though — users expect to jump to full docs from the panel.
Marco: Agree. I can add a canonical docs slug and ensure the crosslink is tracked. Suggest: /docs/console/help/panels?source=help-panel
Liam: I can fix the close button and link behavior. Plan:
- add aria-label: <button aria-label="Close help panel">✕</button>
- ensure focus trap and Escape closes the panel
- set external links to target=_blank + rel=noopener
Olivia: Accessibility nits:
- close button needs accessible name (aria-label or visible text)
- confirm focus returns to the trigger after close
- color contrast for the link CTA is borderline on dark mode
Ava: Also thinking UX: add a small CTA at the bottom “Open full docs” with an external icon and tooltip “Opens in new tab”. Keeps context and makes it discoverable. :external_link:
Marco: I'll create the docs anchor and add a redirect from older slugs. I'll also add the ?source param so analytics can tell panel -> docs conversions.
Priya: Tiny copy tweak: use heading “Help panel” in the panel header, and the CTA text: “Open full docs” (not just “Docs”).
Liam: Cool. I'll open a PR with the changes and ping everyone. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3123 — will include notes about aria, focus, and the new link target.
Ava: Thanks all — can we aim to land this in the next patch? If so, Marco/Marco-docs can push the canonical slug and Priya I'll update the microcopy in the design file. :white_check_mark:
Olivia: One follow-up — please add a short acceptance test for focus restore and for the aria-label on the close button.
Liam: Will do. I'll add the test in the feature branch and mark it in the PR description.
Ava: Perfect. Closing when PR is merged. Thanks!
